title: On the Reliability of LLM-Based Vulnerability Patching Benchmarks
title_zh: 基于大型语言模型的漏洞修复基准测试的可靠性研究

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable potential for automated vulnerability patching, with benchmarks such as SWE-bench driving rapid progress. However, through extensive experience developing, running, and stress-testing such evaluation frameworks, we identify critical but under-examined pitfalls in current benchmarking practices that can substantially distort reported results. These pitfalls span three dimensions: (1) agent-level factors, where prompting strategies, tool availability, and detailed instructions inflate success rates noticeably without improving developer-aligned patch quality; (2) framework-level factors, where permission misconfigurations, infrastructural bugs, and timeout issues silently degrade or artificially boost agent performance; and (3) dataset-level factors, where reliance on bug reports and single proof-of-concept (PoC) tests fails to capture whether patches address root causes or adhere to developer design intent. To demonstrate the effects of these shortcomings, we curate a dataset of 112 real-world historical bugs across 84 open-source C/C++, Go, and Rust projects, each equipped with PoC tests, regression tests, and added developer’s tests that evaluate whether generated patches align with the original developers’ design principles. Through three controlled experiments and multiple case studies, we demonstrate that while LLMs can achieve high PoC passing rates in ideal scenarios, many factors in executing a benchmark can noticeably lower the success rate. Moreover, their developer’s test passing rates remain low and improve only marginally with newer models, revealing that models are increasingly adept at suppressing symptoms but not at producing patches that satisfy upstream developer-authored tests. Our results show that current benchmark scores are highly sensitive to evaluation design choices, and we provide practical guidelines for making future evaluations more rigorous, reliable, and reproducible.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在自动化漏洞修复方面展现出显著潜力，例如 SWE-bench 等基准测试推动了该领域的快速进步。 然而，通过长期开发、运行和压力测试此类评估框架的经验，我们发现当前基准测试实践中存在一些关键但未被充分研究的陷阱，这些陷阱可能严重扭曲所报告的结果。 这些陷阱涵盖三个维度：（1）智能体层面的因素，例如提示策略、工具可用性和详细指令会明显推高成功率，却无法提升与开发者需求一致的修复质量；（2）框架层面的因素，例如权限配置错误、基础设施缺陷和超时问题会在无形中降低或人为夸大智能体的性能；以及（3）数据集层面的因素，例如过度依赖漏洞报告和单一的证明概念（PoC）测试，无法判断修复是否解决了根本原因或符合开发者的设计意图。 为展示这些缺陷的影响，我们整理了一个包含 112 个真实历史漏洞的数据集，涵盖 84 个开源的 C/C++、Go 和 Rust 项目，每个漏洞均配备 PoC 测试、回归测试以及开发者新增的测试用例，用于评估生成的修复是否符合原始开发者的设计原则。 通过三项受控实验和多个案例研究，我们发现，尽管 LLM 在理想场景下能达到较高的 PoC 通过率，但基准测试执行过程中的诸多因素仍会显著降低成功率。 此外，其开发者测试的通过率仍然较低，且新模型仅能带来微小改善，这表明模型越来越擅长缓解表面症状，却难以生成符合上游开发者编写的测试用例的修复方案。 我们的研究结果表明，当前的基准得分对评估设计的选择高度敏感，并提出了实用指南，以助力未来评估更具严谨性、可靠性和可重复性。

paragraphs.en: Automated program repair (APR) with large language models (LLMs) has progressed from synthetic code-completion tasks [ 32 ] to end-to-end agents that localize, patch, and validate fixes against real-world software projects [ 42 , 49 ] . Benchmarks such as SWE-bench [ 12 ] and its multi-language successors [ 48 , 24 , 14 ] have become the de facto yardstick [ 23 ] : a new model is judged by the fraction of issues it “resolves,” [ 18 ] and leaderboards are updated weekly. This enthusiasm has spawned a vibrant ecosystem of agent frameworks, fine-tuned models, and training datasets derived from benchmark traces [ 45 , 22 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的自动化程序修复（APR）已从合成代码补全任务 [ 32 ] 发展到端到端的智能体，这些智能体能定位、修补并验证针对真实世界软件项目的修复方案 [ 42 , 49 ] 。 诸如 SWE-bench [ 12 ] 及其多语言后续版本 [ 48 , 24 , 14 ] 的基准测试已成为事实上的衡量标准 [ 23 ]：一个新模型的评价依据是它能“解决”的问题比例，[ 18 ] 而排行榜则每周更新。 这种热情催生了充满活力的智能体框架、微调模型以及源自基准测试轨迹的训练数据集生态系统 [ 45 , 22 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, the same ecosystem is remarkably opaque about how those numbers are produced. A typical benchmark run places an agent in a buggy repository with a bug report, exposes some set of tools and auxiliary artifacts, and scores the resulting patch against one or more automated oracles. Seemingly small choices, such as whether the harness tells the agent how to build the project, or whether the target’s git history is included in the workspace, can significantly affect the reported pass rate. Worse, an agent can “pass” a benchmark case by silencing the symptom used to score it while leaving the underlying defect, or even the whole codebase, demonstrably worse off [ 39 ] . If these results are then used to train the next generation of code models, the pitfalls are baked into model weights [ 43 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 遗憾的是，同一生态系统对这些数字是如何生成的却异常不透明。 一次典型的基准测试运行会将一个智能体置于一个存在错误的代码仓库中，并提供一份错误报告、一组工具及辅助资源，然后依据一个或多个自动化评判标准对由此产生的补丁进行评分。 看似微小的选择，例如测试框架是否告知智能体如何构建项目，或者目标项目的 Git 历史是否包含在工作区中，都可能显著影响所报告的通过率。 更糟糕的是，一个智能体可能通过掩盖用于评分的症状来“通过”某个基准测试用例，而实际上底层缺陷甚至整个代码库的状况却明显变得更糟 [ 39 ] 。 如果将这些结果用于训练下一代代码模型，那么其中的问题就会内化到模型权重中 [ 43 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In this paper we argue that the benchmarking pipeline itself , not just the model or the dataset, is a first-class research artifact that deserves principled design and critical scrutiny: benchmark scores are highly sensitive to evaluation design and can materially misrepresent model capability. Drawing on our experience developing and stress-testing LLM patching agent harnesses across three languages, we identify a taxonomy of pitfalls along three dimensions: Agent-level factors (§ 3.1 ): prompting choices, tool permissions, feedback oracles, and auxiliary capabilities such as Internet access; framework-level factors (§ 3.2 ): permission misconfigurations, timeouts, hidden agent mechanics, and post-agent test interference; and dataset-level factors (§ 3.3 ): how vulnerabilities are described, whether PoCs are provided, how the source is packaged, and how “success” is operationalized.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们认为基准测试流程本身——而不仅仅是模型或数据集——是一种一级研究工具，值得进行有原则的设计和严格审视：基准测试分数对评估设计极为敏感，并可能严重歪曲模型的实际能力。 基于我们在三种语言中开发并压力测试大型语言模型（LLM）补丁智能体系统的经验，我们识别出三个维度上的典型陷阱分类：智能体层面的因素（§ 3.1）：提示词选择、工具权限、反馈机制以及互联网访问等辅助能力；框架层面的因素（§ 3.2）：权限配置错误、超时、隐藏的智能体机制以及智能体测试后的干扰；以及数据集层面的因素（§ 3.3）：漏洞描述方式、是否提供概念验证（PoC）、源代码的打包方式，以及“成功”的定义与实现方式。

paragraphs.en: To study these factors empirically, we curate 112 historical bugs across 84 C/C++, Go, and Rust projects, each packaged in a reproducible Docker harness (§ 4 ) with PoCs, regression tests, and developer’s tests (§ 4.2 )—tests that encode the developer’s design intent, not just the absence of a crash. We then run three controlled experiments and five case studies to probe how each factor shifts apparent patch quality (§ 5 , § 6 ).

paragraphs.en: Our experiments are designed to isolate principles rather than individual knobs. For example, across a modern frontier model, we observe that detailed build and test instructions lift PoC-pass rates by a large margin in C/C++ and much less so in Go/Rust—because in Go/Rust the build system is uniform and discoverable from the repository, whereas C/C++ projects’ build systems are heterogeneous. This illustrates one of the principles we demonstrate in this paper: the reported success rate of a benchmark is only meaningful relative to the information its harness makes available to the agent . We generalize this style of observation into a set of guidelines (§ 8 ) for how benchmarks should be built and reported.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验旨在揭示基本原理，而非针对单个参数进行调整。 例如，在一个现代前沿模型中，我们观察到：详细的构建和测试说明能将 C/C++ 项目中 PoC 的通过率大幅提升，但在 Go/Rust 项目中提升效果则小得多——这是因为 Go/Rust 项目的构建系统统一且可从仓库中直接获取，而 C/C++ 项目的构建系统则各不相同。 这说明了我们在本文中所展示的原则之一：基准测试所报告的成功率，只有相对于其执行框架为智能体提供的信息而言才有意义。 我们将这种观察方法总结为一套指导方针（§ 8），用于规范基准测试的构建与报告方式。

paragraphs.en: Contributions. We make the following contributions: (1) A three-level taxonomy of pitfalls in LLM vulnerability patching benchmarks, grounded in concrete failures we observed in practice. (2) A controlled evaluation dataset and harness designed to isolate benchmarking factors: 112 real-world security-relevant bugs across three languages, each packaged with reproducible builds, PoCs, regression tests, and developer’s tests derived from upstream commits. (3) Three controlled experiments quantifying how prompting, tool availability, PoC access, and model choice move both PoC-pass and developer-test-pass rates; and five case studies that show how “incidental” framework issues can silently dominate headline numbers. (4) A survey of 13 existing real-world patching benchmarks and vulnerability datasets along the same factor axes, showing that most exhibit at least one of the pitfalls we characterize. (5) A set of concrete guidelines and a reporting checklist for future benchmark designers.

paragraphs.en: Scope. This work is not intended to propose another benchmark for model ranking . Instead, the dataset is deliberately designed to highlight evaluation pitfalls under controlled conditions rather than to support competitive comparison. Our contribution is methodological: to strengthen the validity, interpretability, and reproducibility of reported APR results and of the training signals subsequently derived from them.

paragraphs.en: Modern LLM patching systems typically wrap a frontier model (e.g., Claude, GPT, Gemini) in an agent harness : a scaffold that exposes shell, file-editing, and sometimes web-browsing tools, loops over model turns, and terminates when the agent emits a “done” signal or hits a step/turn budget [ 46 , 50 ] . A typical patching task gives the agent: (a) a textual description of the bug (often a GitHub issue), (b) access to the target repository at a buggy commit, and (c) optionally a PoC input and/or instructions related to building and testing the target [ 47 , 50 ] . The agent is graded by an automated oracle, usually whether the PoC no longer reproduces the crash and whether a reference test suite still passes.
paragraphs.zh: 现代的大语言模型（LLM）补丁系统通常会将一个前沿模型（例如 Claude、GPT、Gemini）封装到一个智能体框架中：该框架提供外壳、文件编辑以及有时是网页浏览工具，循环执行模型交互，并在智能体发出“完成”信号或达到步骤/交互次数上限时终止 [ 46 , 50 ]。 一个典型的补丁任务会向智能体提供：(a) 问题的文本描述（通常是 GitHub 上的问题报告），(b) 访问包含错误的目标仓库中特定提交版本的权利，以及 (c) 可选的 PoC 输入和/或与构建及测试目标相关的说明 [ 47 , 50 ]。 智能体由一个自动化评判器进行评分，通常依据的标准是：PoC 是否不再复现崩溃问题，以及参考测试套件是否仍然通过测试。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks occupy a wide design space, but their evaluation protocols have converged on a surprisingly narrow notion of correctness: did the supplied test(s) pass? [ 47 , 51 ] This definition is seductive because it is cheap and objective. But it conflates very different outcomes: (1) the agent produced a patch the original maintainer would have accepted; (2) the agent produced a patch that makes the oracle happy, e.g., by short-circuiting the crashing code path, disabling the feature, or special-casing the PoC input; or (3) the agent produced a patch that looks perfect, by taking advantage of a pitfall in the benchmark, such as git history, Internet access, permission misconfiguration, etc. All of the outcomes above appear identical on a leaderboard. We argue that the difference matters for two downstream uses:
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基准测试覆盖了广泛的设计空间，但它们的评估协议却惊人地收敛于一个狭隘的正确性概念：所提供的测试是否通过？ [ 47 , 51 ] 这一定义之所以具有吸引力，是因为它成本低廉且客观。 但它将截然不同的结果混为一谈：（1）智能体生成的补丁是原始维护者会接受的；（2）智能体生成的补丁让“神谕”满意，例如通过短路导致崩溃的代码路径、禁用功能，或对 PoC 输入进行特殊处理；或者（3）智能体利用基准测试中的漏洞（如 Git 历史、网络访问、权限配置错误等），生成一个看似完美的补丁。 在排行榜上，上述所有结果都显得完全相同。 我们认为，这种差异对以下两种后续用途至关重要：

paragraphs.en: Training. Increasingly, agent trajectories that “pass” the benchmark are used as supervised or reinforcement-learning signal [ 53 , 21 , 37 ] . Every false-positive pass is a data point that teaches the model to produce similar surface-level patch.

paragraphs.en: We organize the pitfalls into three levels, corresponding to the three artifacts a benchmark designer controls: the agent (what the model is allowed to do), the framework (how its behavior is measured), and the dataset (what it is measured on). We define a factor as any variable in the evaluation pipeline that can change the measured success rate without changing the underlying model. We refer to factors studied via controlled ablations as systematic , and those revealed through individual failures as incidental ; both can substantially affect reported performance. These factors are not independent. In practice, their interactions can amplify effects. Throughout this section and in § 5 , § 6 , we analyze factors in isolation for clarity, but we note that real-world benchmarks might exhibit multiple interacting factors simultaneously (§ 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将潜在问题分为三个层级，分别对应基准测试设计者所控制的三种要素：智能体（模型被允许执行的操作）、框架（衡量其行为的方式）以及数据集（衡量行为的具体内容）。 我们将“因素”定义为评估流程中任何能够改变所测成功率、但不会改变底层模型的变量。 我们通过受控消融研究的因素称为“系统性因素”，而通过个别失败案例揭示的因素则称为“偶然性因素”；两者都可能显著影响报告的性能结果。 这些因素并非相互独立。 在实际应用中，它们之间的相互作用可能会放大效应。 在本节以及第 5 节、第 6 节中，为便于分析，我们将各因素单独考察，但需要指出的是，现实中的基准测试可能同时存在多个相互作用的因子（第 7 节）。

paragraphs.en: A1. Build and test instructions in the prompt (systematic). An impactful prompt-level variable we found is whether the agent is told, in-context, how to build and test the project. Without such guidance, a capable agent must infer the build system from files scattered across the repository; with it, the agent can validate its own changes after every edit. We show in § 5.1 that supplying these instructions raises PoC-pass rates by ≈ 20 \approx 20 % in C/C++ cases and by a far smaller margin in Go/Rust cases, where the build system is more uniform.
paragraphs.zh: A1. 在提示词中构建并测试说明（系统化的）。 我们发现的一个具有影响力的提示词级别变量是，是否在上下文中告知智能体如何构建和测试项目。 如果没有这样的指导，一个能力强的智能体必须从仓库中分散的文件中推断出构建系统；而有了指导，智能体每次编辑后都能验证自己的更改。 我们在 § 5.1 中表明，提供这些说明可将 C/C++ 案例中的 PoC 通过率提高约 20 \approx 20%，而在 Go/Rust 案例中提升幅度要小得多，因为它们的构建系统更为统一。

paragraphs.en: A2. Internet and web-search access (incidental). LLM agents are increasingly given live web-search and URL-fetch tools [ 35 ] . For a benchmark drawn from public GitHub issues, these tools leak ground truth in several ways. We observed several case traces where the agent directly searched for the issue number and retrieved the fix verbatim (§ 6.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: A2. 互联网和网页搜索访问（附带性）。 LLM 智能体越来越多地被赋予实时网页搜索和 URL 获取工具 [ 35 ]。 对于从公共 GitHub 问题中选取的基准测试，这些工具以多种方式泄露了真实答案。 我们观察到几个案例，其中智能体直接搜索了问题编号并逐字获取了修复方案（§ 6.1）。

sents.en: Internet and web-search access (incidental).
sents.zh: 互联网和网页搜索访问（附带性）。

sents.en: LLM agents are increasingly given live web-search and URL-fetch tools [ 35 ] .

paragraphs.en: F1. Permission misconfiguration (incidental). A harness typically mounts the target source tree together with sensitive metadata related to the issue. If the agent is granted overly broad permissions, it may access these files and extract information about the ground-truth fix. Conversely, if permissions are too restrictive (e.g., preventing installation of dependencies required for a legitimate build), the agent may underperform for reasons unrelated to its capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: F1. 权限配置错误（偶然发生）。 一个工具通常会连同与问题相关的敏感元数据一起挂载目标源代码树。 如果授予智能体的权限过于宽泛，它可能会访问这些文件并提取有关真实修复方案的信息。 相反，如果权限设置过于严格（例如，阻止了合法构建所需的依赖项安装），智能体可能会因与其能力无关的原因而表现不佳。

sents.en: Conversely, if permissions are too restrictive (e.g., preventing installation of dependencies required for a legitimate build), the agent may underperform for reasons unrelated to its capabilities.

paragraphs.en: F2. Timeouts and hidden mechanics (incidental). Closed-source agent systems contain behaviors that are not obvious from the documentation alone. Evidently, we observed one such behavior in Claude Code, leading to unintended timeouts (§ 6.4 ). Analogously, slow-building projects (e.g., large C/C++ code bases) can exhaust wall-clock budgets before the agent has had a chance to test. These effects produce false negatives that are indistinguishable from real model failures.
paragraphs.zh: F2。 超时与隐藏机制（偶然性）。 闭源智能体系统包含仅凭文档无法直接察觉的行为。 显然，我们在 Claude Code 中观察到了其中一种行为，导致意外超时（§ 6.4）。 类似地，构建缓慢的项目（例如大型 C/C++ 代码库）可能在智能体尚未有机会进行测试时，就已耗尽实际运行时间预算。 这些效应会产生假阴性结果，且无法与真实的模型故障区分开来。

sents.en: Timeouts and hidden mechanics (incidental).
sents.zh: 超时与隐藏机制（偶然性）。

sents.en: Closed-source agent systems contain behaviors that are not obvious from the documentation alone.
sents.zh: 闭源智能体系统包含仅凭文档无法直接察觉的行为。

sents.en: Evidently, we observed one such behavior in Claude Code, leading to unintended timeouts (§ 6.4 ).

sents.zh: 类似地，构建缓慢的项目（例如大型 C/C++ 代码库）可能在智能体尚未有机会进行测试时，就已耗尽实际运行时间预算。

sents.zh: 这些效应会产生假阴性结果，且无法与真实的模型故障区分开来。

paragraphs.en: F3. Agent-written tests interfering with the evaluation pipeline (incidental). Some agents routinely create their own tests to validate a fix. If the evaluation framework subsequently applies additional tests to a file that the agent has already modified to add its own tests, the test application step may fail due to conflicts. As a result, the case is marked as a failure even though the patch itself is correct (§ 6.5 ). This is particularly problematic: the agent follows the intended workflow and produces a valid fix, yet the failure arises entirely from the evaluation pipeline rather than the agent’s behavior.
paragraphs.zh: F3。 智能体编写的测试干扰了评估流程（偶然现象）。 一些智能体会常规地创建自己的测试来验证修复方案。 如果评估框架随后对智能体已修改以添加自身测试的文件应用额外的测试，则由于冲突，测试执行步骤可能会失败。 因此，尽管补丁本身是正确的，该案例仍被标记为失败（§ 6.5）。 这个问题尤其严重：智能体遵循了预期的工作流程并生成了有效的修复方案，但失败完全是由评估流程而非智能体的行为引起的。

paragraphs.en: D1. Oracle granularity: PoC versus developer’s test (systematic). The single most common oracle in APR benchmarks is “does the PoC still crash?” [ 9 , 44 , 51 ] This is a necessary but insufficient condition for correctness. We propose developer’s tests (§ 4.2 ) as a practical middle ground between PoC-only and full regression testing: a targeted, author-authored oracle that encodes the fix’s intent .
paragraphs.zh: D1. 验证标准粒度：概念验证（PoC）与开发者的测试（系统性）。 APR基准测试中最常见的单一验证标准是：“概念验证是否仍然崩溃？”[ 9 , 44 , 51 ] 这是正确性的必要但非充分条件。 我们提出将开发者的测试（§ 4.2 ）作为在仅使用概念验证与完整回归测试之间的实用折中方案：一种由作者亲自编写的、有针对性的验证标准，用以体现修复的意图。

sents.zh: 验证标准粒度：概念验证（PoC）与开发者的测试（系统性）。

paragraphs.en: D2. PoC format and framing (systematic). When a PoC is included, how it is presented matters. A raw binary input tells the agent nothing about intent, while a test harness (e.g., a Go test function) reveals which API is exercised and with what expectations. We show in § 5.2 that PoCs presented as source-level harnesses yield markedly higher PoC-pass rates than binary PoCs, independent of patch quality.
paragraphs.zh: D2。 PoC 的格式与框架（系统性）。 当包含一个 PoC 时，其呈现方式至关重要。 原始二进制输入无法让智能体了解任何意图，而测试框架（例如 Go 测试函数）则能揭示具体调用了哪个 API 以及相关的预期结果。 我们在 § 5.2 中表明，以源代码级测试框架形式呈现的 PoC，其通过率明显高于二进制 PoC，且与补丁质量无关。

sents.en: When a PoC is included, how it is presented matters.

sents.en: A raw binary input tells the agent nothing about intent, while a test harness (e.g., a Go test function) reveals which API is exercised and with what expectations.

paragraphs.en: D3. Source provenance and contamination (incidental). The method used to retrieve the source code determines what incidental signals are exposed in the workspace. Shallow clones, tarballs, and git worktrees each reveal different amounts of history. In particular, the presence of an unsanitized Git history is risky: a future commit in the history may contain the upstream fix for the buggy version (§ 6.2 ).

paragraphs.en: D4. Language balance (systematic). Most benchmarks are dominated by a single language (typically Python or Java for SWE-bench variants). We find that the sensitivity of patch quality to specific factors varies sharply by language: C/C++ benchmarks are more sensitive to harness quality, Go/Rust benchmarks are more sensitive to PoC framing.

paragraphs.en: Each case is pinned to a specific trigger commit and patch commit , and is packaged as a self-contained Docker build. The per-case directory includes: (1) target-specific scripts for building, reproducing the PoC, and running regression tests. The PoC reproduction script is carefully designed to return a non-zero exit code only when a crash associated with the vulnerability is triggered, rather than when the program itself exits with a non-zero status (e.g., due to invalid inputs). (2) PoC inputs, which are binary artifacts (most C/C++ cases) or source-level harnesses (all Go and Rust cases). (3) The upstream developer’s patch, used exclusively by the ground-truth validator (§ 4.3 ) and never exposed to the agent. (4) The developer’s test derived from the upstream commit (§ 4.2 ). (5) The bug description provided to the agent: a textual issue/advisory write-up, a sanitizer crash trace, or both, depending on what is available upstream. (6) A YAML configuration file that captures metadata and pins all of the above components.
paragraphs.zh: 每个案例都与特定的触发提交和补丁提交相关联，并被打包为一个自包含的 Docker 构建。 每个案例的目录包括：(1) 用于构建、重现 PoC 和运行回归测试的目标特定脚本。 PoC 重现脚本经过精心设计，仅当与漏洞相关的崩溃被触发时才会返回非零退出码，而不是程序本身因非零状态退出（例如，由于无效输入）时返回。 (2) PoC 输入，这些是二进制产物（大多数 C/C++ 案例）或源代码级别的测试框架（所有 Go 和 Rust 案例）。 (3) 上游开发者的补丁，仅由基准验证器（§ 4.3）使用，且绝不会暴露给智能体。 (4) 源自上游提交的开发者测试（§ 4.2）。 (5) 提供给智能体的漏洞描述：根据上游提供的信息，可能是一个文本形式的问题/建议说明、一个 sanitizer 崩溃跟踪，或两者兼有。 (6) 一个 YAML 配置文件，用于记录元数据并固定上述所有组件。

paragraphs.en: Data collection and curation. Cases were collected by scraping historical security issues and fix commits, restricted to projects whose build-and-test cycle completes in under half an hour in our containerized harness. For C/C++ cases, PoCs are the binary inputs attached to the upstream issue; the bug description is the GitHub or GitLab issue text combined with a sanitizer crash trace we reproduce in the harness. For Go cases, the bug description is taken from the upstream issue or GHSA advisory; PoCs are source-level Go programs, of which 25 were imported from the upstream issue or advisory and 37 were minimal harnesses we hand-wrote when no upstream PoC was available. For Rust cases, the bug description is taken from RUSTSEC advisories, GHSA advisories, or the upstream issue; PoCs are source-level Rust programs sourced from the RUSTSEC advisory’s reference exploit when available, with the remaining cases using harnesses adapted from the upstream report or hand-written by us. Each case is validated by our ground-truth validator (§ 4.3 ): with the upstream patch applied, the target must build successfully, avoid crashing on the PoC, and pass all regression and developer’s tests. A case is admitted into the dataset only if it passes all four phases; cases that failed any phase were either repaired or discarded, yielding the final 112 curated instances.
paragraphs.zh: 数据收集与整理。 我们通过抓取历史安全问题和修复提交来收集案例，且仅限于那些在容器化测试环境中构建和测试周期少于半小时的项目。 对于 C/C++ 案例，PoC 是附加在上游问题中的二进制输入；缺陷描述则结合 GitHub 或 GitLab 问题文本与我们在测试环境中复现的净化器崩溃追踪信息。 对于 Go 案例，缺陷描述取自上游问题或 GHSA 公告；PoC 则是源代码级别的 Go 程序，其中 25 个是从上游问题或公告中导入的，另外 37 个是在没有可用上游 PoC 时由我们手动编写的最小测试程序。 对于 Rust 案例，缺陷描述取自 RUSTSEC 公告、GHSA 公告或上游问题；PoC 则来自 RUSTSEC 公告中的参考漏洞利用程序（如存在），其余案例则使用改编自上游报告或由我们手动编写的测试程序。 每个案例都需通过我们的基准验证器（§ 4.3）进行验证：在应用上游补丁后，目标必须成功构建、在运行 PoC 时不发生崩溃，并通过所有回归测试和开发者测试。 只有当某个案例通过全部四个阶段时，它才会被纳入数据集；任何阶段失败的案例要么被修复，要么被舍弃，最终得到 112 个整理好的实例。

In our dataset, we extract these tests from the upstream fix commit and reconstruct them as a patch named test.diff , which can be applied to the pre-fix source tree. This allows us to execute developer’s tests in the same manner as the project’s regression suite. Conceptually, a developer’s test answers a different question than a PoC:

paragraphs.en: Example: PHP range() type confusion (GH-13094).

paragraphs.en: To illustrate the difference between PoC-based evaluation and developer-intent evaluation, consider PHP issue GH-13094 [ 28 ] , a type-confusion bug in range() . The bug arises because mixed-type inputs can be misclassified as string inputs, leading the function to dereference a non-string operand and crash on the PoC range(9.9, []) .

paragraphs.en: Two patches can plausibly “fix” this bug. The upstream developer patch replaces the brittle arithmetic condition with a direct semantic check for mixed non-string inputs, preserving PHP’s intended coercion behavior. A second, more defensive patch instead adds type checks immediately before the unsafe string dereference and throws an error when either operand is not a string. Both patches suppress the original crash and pass the pre-existing PHP regression suite.
paragraphs.zh: 两种补丁都可以合理地“修复”这个错误。 上游开发者的补丁将脆弱的算术条件替换为针对混合非字符串输入的直接语义检查，同时保留了 PHP 预期的类型转换行为。 第二种更具防御性的补丁则是在不安全的字符串解引用操作之前立即添加类型检查，当任一操作数不是字符串时抛出错误。 这两种补丁都能抑制原有的崩溃问题，并且通过现有的 PHP 回归测试套件。

paragraphs.en: However, the two patches are not behaviorally equivalent. PHP’s range() is intended to permit mixed numeric/string inputs [ 30 ] such as range(9.9, '0') , coercing the string operand and producing a numeric range. The upstream fix preserves this behavior; the defensive patch rejects it with ValueError . The developer’s test added in the upstream commit encodes exactly this expected behavior by checking the output of range(9.9, '0') and asserting it to an exact array value. As a result, the upstream patch passes the developer’s test, while the defensive patch fails.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这两个补丁在行为上并不等价。 PHP 的 range() 函数旨在允许混合的数值/字符串输入 [30]，例如 range(9.9, '0')，它会将字符串操作数强制转换为数值，并生成一个数值范围。 上游的修复保留了这种行为；而防御性补丁则会因 ValueError 拒绝这种输入。 开发者在上游提交中添加的测试通过检查 range(9.9, '0') 的输出并将其与一个精确的数组值进行断言，从而完全编码了这种预期的行为。 因此，上游补丁通过了开发者的测试，而防御性补丁则失败了。

paragraphs.en: Authoring fidelity. Because developer’s tests are derived directly from upstream commits, they reflect the maintainer’s notion of correctness rather than ours. We only normalize test infrastructure (e.g., expected-output formatting, harness wiring) when necessary to run in our sandbox. Cases whose upstream commit does not add or meaningfully modify a test are excluded from the dataset rather than instrumented post-hoc by us; we discuss the resulting threats in § 9 .
paragraphs.zh: 编写保真度。 由于开发者的测试直接源自上游提交，因此它们反映的是维护者对正确性的理解，而非我们的理解。 我们仅在必要时对测试基础设施（例如，预期输出格式、测试框架接线）进行标准化，以便在我们的沙盒中运行。 那些上游提交未添加或未能实质性修改测试的案例，会从数据集中排除，而不是由我们在事后进行标记；我们在第 9 节中讨论了由此产生的威胁。

paragraphs.en: After the agent produces a patch, we evaluate it in four phases: (1) Build: re-build the target project, with the LLM-generated patch applied, to completion. (2) PoC: execute each PoC ten times and require that no run result in a vulnerability-related crash. Repeating executions helps capture vulnerabilities with non-deterministic trigger rates (e.g., race conditions), ensuring they are reliably detected. (3) Regression: run the target project’s built-in regression test (before applying the developer’s test). (4) Developer’s test: apply the developer’s test patch file to the patched tree and re-run the regression test, which now includes the added developer’s test.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体生成补丁后，我们会分四个阶段进行评估：(1) 构建：重新构建目标项目，并应用由 LLM 生成的补丁，直至完成。 (2) PoC：执行每个 PoC 十次，且要求没有任何一次运行出现与漏洞相关的崩溃。 重复执行有助于捕捉触发率不确定的漏洞（例如竞争条件），从而确保这些漏洞能够被可靠地检测出来。 (3) 回归测试：运行目标项目的内置回归测试（在应用开发者的测试之前）。 (4) 开发者的测试：将开发者的测试补丁文件应用到已打补丁的树中，并重新运行回归测试，此时该测试已包含新增的开发者的测试。

paragraphs.en: Interpretation. Including build/test instructions raises overall PoC-pass from 74.1% to 77.7%, but the effect is highly uneven across languages. The C/C++ slice improves by 20 percentage points (72.0% to 92.0%), whereas Rust changes only modestly (80.0% to 84.0%) and Go is nearly unchanged (72.6% to 69.4%, a slight negative within the noise of a single run). This matches the structure of the ecosystems in our dataset: Go and Rust projects usually expose recoverable defaults for building and testing such as go build & go test and cargo build & cargo test , while C/C++ projects rely on far more heterogeneous build and test procedures (such as CMake, Autotools, hand-written Makefiles, project-specific shell wrappers, etc.). By contrast, regression-pass rates remain constant overall (97.3% in both conditions), and developer-test-pass changes only slightly (41.1% to 43.8%). Together, these results suggest that build/test instructions mainly alter the benchmark’s information budget—especially in C/C++—rather than patch quality as measured by our stronger developer-test oracle.
paragraphs.zh: 解释。 包含构建/测试说明后，整体 PoC 通过率从 74.1% 提升至 77.7%，但不同语言间的影响差异显著。 C/C++ 部分的提升幅度为 20 个百分点（从 72.0% 升至 92.0%），而 Rust 的变化则较为有限（从 80.0% 升至 84.0%），Go 几乎未变（从 72.6% 降至 69.4%，这一轻微下降可能属于单次运行结果的随机波动）。 这与数据集中各生态系统的结构相符：Go 和 Rust 项目通常会提供可恢复的默认构建与测试命令，例如 go build & go test 和 cargo build & cargo test；而 C/C++ 项目则依赖更为多样化的构建与测试流程（如 CMake、Autotools、手写 Makefile、项目特定的 shell 包装脚本等）。 相比之下，回归测试通过率整体保持稳定（两种条件下均为 97.3%），开发者测试通过率的变化也仅轻微（从 41.1% 升至 43.8%）。 综合来看，这些结果表明，构建/测试说明主要改变了基准测试的信息供给——尤其是在 C/C++ 中——而非通过我们更严格的开发者测试判据所衡量的质量改进。

paragraphs.en: Takeaway. The headline PoC-pass rate of an otherwise identical benchmark can shift by 20 percentage points in C/C++ purely as a function of whether the harness discloses build/test instructions in the prompt. paragraphs.en: Setup. We study two subsets of the dataset according to the natural form of their PoC artifacts. The Go subset (62 cases) uses source-harness PoCs written in Go that exercise specific APIs in the target package and trigger the vulnerability; the C/C++ subset (25 cases) uses binary or text-blob PoCs fed directly to an executable. For each subset, we compare a no-PoC condition against one in which the PoC is exposed to the agent: inline source code for Go and a file path for C/C++. Build and test instructions are included in both conditions.

paragraphs.en: Expected effect. Exposing a PoC should help most when the artifact is readable and reveals API-level intent, as with source-level harnesses. paragraphs.en: Interpretation. In Go, adding the source-harness PoC raises PoC-pass from 69.4% to 95.2% and developer-test-pass from 41.9% to 48.4%. In C/C++, exposing the binary blob yields no measurable change in PoC-pass (92.0% in both conditions) and no change in developer-test-pass (36.0% in both), with only a small increase in regression-pass (88.0% to 92.0%). The asymmetry is consistent with the information each PoC carries. A source-level Go harness exposes both the crashing call site and the API-level expectation, whereas a binary input is largely opaque. In our C/C++ cases, that opacity matters even more because the bug description already includes an ASan stack trace that localizes the fault.

Two benchmarks that nominally “provide a PoC” are therefore not comparable unless they also disclose the PoC’s representation. Crucially, the gains accrue far more to oracle alignment than to developer-aligned patch quality.

paragraphs.en: Interpretation. PoC-pass rises steadily across model generations, from 77.7% to 84.8% to 90.2%, approaching saturation by Opus 4.7. Developer-test-pass also improves, but much more slowly: 43.8% to 48.2% to 60.7%. The resulting PoC–Dev gap remains large throughout, shrinking only from 33.9 to 29.5 percentage points, and even with Opus 4.7, 32.7% of PoC-passing cases still fail the developer’s test. In other words, roughly one in three patches that appear successful under a PoC-only oracle would still be rejected by an oracle aligned with maintainer intent. Regression-pass remains nearly flat (97.3%, 94.6%, 94.6%), suggesting that pre-existing regression suites do little to distinguish symptom suppression from developer-acceptable repair.
paragraphs.zh: 解读。 PoC 通过率在各模型代际中稳步上升，从 77.7% 到 84.8%，再到 90.2%，到 Opus 4.7 时已接近饱和。 开发者测试通过率也有提升，但速度慢得多：从 43.8% 到 48.2%，再到 60.7%。 由此产生的 PoC–开发者测试差距始终很大，仅从 33.9 个百分点缩小到 29.5 个百分点；即使到了 Opus 4.7，仍有 32.7% 的通过 PoC 的案例未能通过开发者的测试。 换言之，在仅以 PoC 作为判断标准的“神谕”下看似成功的补丁中，大约每三个就会有一个仍会被与维护者意图一致的神谕拒绝。 回归测试通过率几乎保持不变（97.3%、94.6%、94.6%），这表明现有的回归测试套件在区分症状抑制与开发者可接受的修复方面作用有限。

paragraphs.en: Takeaway. These results show that PoC-pass is a misleading progress signal near the top of the capability curve: a PoC-only benchmark would suggest that the task is nearly solved, whereas developer’s tests reveal substantial remaining headroom. Every benchmark currently using only PoC/test oracles is therefore reporting a scaling curve that overstates how much of the remaining headroom matters to practitioners.
paragraphs.zh: 结论。 这些结果表明，在能力曲线接近顶部时，通过证明概念（PoC）是一个具有误导性的进展信号：仅基于 PoC 的基准测试会让人觉得任务几乎已经解决，而开发者的测试则揭示了仍有大量提升空间。 因此，所有目前仅使用 PoC/测试预言机的基准测试，所报告的扩展曲线都夸大了剩余提升空间对从业者的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Across all three experiments, three patterns recur. First, developer-test-pass is tightly constrained by PoC-pass: among the 734 case-level outcomes in our condition-by-language analysis (aggregating all controlled conditions in § 5 ), only a single case has PoC=fail and Dev=pass simultaneously. Second, the ratio of developer-test-pass to PoC-pass varies substantially by condition and model, indicating that some benchmark configurations improve oracle alignment much more than they improve true patch quality. Third, the pool of “PoC-only” patches, i.e. cases where the agent suppresses the PoC but fails the developer’s test, remains large across model generations: 38 cases for Sonnet 4.0, 41 for Sonnet 4.5, and 33 for Opus 4.7. This persistent slab is exactly the region that PoC-only benchmarks miscount as progress.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有三项实验中，有三个模式反复出现。 首先，“开发者测试通过”严格受“PoC通过”的约束：在我们按条件与语言进行的分析中（汇总了第5节所有受控条件），734个案例级结果中，只有一个案例同时满足“PoC=失败”和“开发者=通过”。 其次，“开发者测试通过”与“PoC通过”的比例因条件和模型而有显著差异，这表明某些基准配置对“神谕对齐”的改善程度远大于对真实补丁质量的提升。 第三，“仅通过PoC”的补丁池——即智能体抑制了PoC但未能通过开发者测试的案例——在不同代模型中依然规模庞大：Sonnet 4.0有38个案例，Sonnet 4.5有41个，Opus 4.7则有33个。 这个持续存在的区域正是“仅通过PoC”的基准测试错误地视为进展的部分。

paragraphs.en: The experiments in § 5 show how systematic factors manifest at scale. In this section, we walk through five concrete incidents drawn from real runs with Claude Code paired with Claude Sonnet 4.5, in which a single framework- or dataset-level decision either leaked the answer to the agent or caused the pipeline to mis-score a correct patch. We call these factors incidental because they affect only a subset of cases rather than the dataset as a whole. Our goal is to show that for model training, leakage detection, or leaderboard reporting, even rare incidents matter. Every excerpt below is taken from raw agent traces. These traces are archived in the artifact.
paragraphs.zh: § 5 中的实验展示了系统性因素如何在大规模场景下显现。 在本节中，我们将详细分析五个源自实际运行案例的具体事件：在这些案例中，Claude Code 与 Claude Sonnet 4.5 协同运行，而框架或数据集层面的单一决策要么将答案泄露给了智能体，要么导致流程对正确的补丁评分错误。 我们将这些因素称为“附带因素”，因为它们仅影响部分案例，而非整个数据集。 我们的目标是表明：在模型训练、泄露检测或排行榜报告等场景中，即便是罕见事件也具有重要意义。 以下所有摘录均直接取自原始智能体追踪记录。 这些追踪记录已存档于该成果包中。

paragraphs.en: Trace. The agent’s first four tool calls after reading the bug description were all web fetches surrounding ReadUvarint , with the final call fetching the upstream patch commit directly. Eleven turns later, the agent committed a fix and reported success with the line “The fix follows the same approach used in the Go standard library fix,” citing the very URL it had fetched. Both the PoC and the developer’s test passed.
paragraphs.zh: 追踪。 在读取错误描述后，该智能体的前四次工具调用均为围绕 ReadUvarint 的网络获取操作，最后一次调用直接获取了上游的补丁提交。 十一个回合之后，该智能体提交了一个修复方案，并用“此修复采用了与 Go 标准库修复相同的方法”这句话报告成功，同时引用了它之前获取的那个 URL。 概念验证和开发者的测试均通过了。

paragraphs.en: Mechanism. Public GitHub issues and security advisories are indexed by search engines within hours of being filed. For any benchmark derived from historical bugs, the ground-truth commit is at most one web query away, and the case identifier or the bug description usually contains enough hints (CVE id, GitHub issue number, function name) to land the agent on it on the first try.
paragraphs.zh: 机制。 公共 GitHub 问题和安全建议在提交后数小时内就会被搜索引擎索引。 对于任何基于历史漏洞的基准测试，其真实对应的提交最多只需一次网络查询即可找到，且案例标识符或漏洞描述通常包含足够的提示（CVE ID、GitHub 问题编号、函数名），足以让智能体首次尝试就定位到它。

paragraphs.en: Implication. For benchmarks targeting historical bugs, web tools must be disabled by default and explicitly re-enabled only when the benchmark’s claim is about tool-use rather than about patching. Our harness disables WebSearch and WebFetch through the Claude Code permissions.deny list; frameworks without an equivalent knob must isolate the container network. Note that disabling these two tools is not in itself sufficient: an agent that retains Bash can run curl or git fetch against the public origin remote. We address that channel in Case 2.
paragraphs.zh: 含义。 对于针对历史漏洞的基准测试，网络工具必须默认禁用，并且只有在基准测试的主张涉及工具使用而非补丁修复时，才需要显式重新启用。 我们的测试框架通过 Claude Code 的 permissions.deny 列表禁用了 WebSearch 和 WebFetch；没有等效控制选项的框架必须隔离容器网络。 请注意，仅禁用这两种工具本身并不足够：一个仍保留 Bash 的智能体可以运行 curl 或 git fetch 来访问公共远程仓库。 我们在案例 2 中处理了该通道。

paragraphs.en: Setup. This case study is observed in commit 524f142 of the Go package bluemonday [ 26 ] , which is an XSS sanitizer regression where strings.ToLower() is used to compare HTML tag names, against a variant of our harness in which the project’s full upstream .git history was preserved. paragraphs.en: Trace. The agent’s reasoning before any code edit acknowledged the regression hint provided by the bug description and decided to look for the original fix from git history. It then issued a single git log query, filtering by issue #56, and inspected the resulting commit. By doing so, it found commit 5793ebc , which contains a unified diff that has the exact API change as the upstream fix for the current case. The agent’s subsequent edits track that diff almost line-for-line; it concludes by quoting “the fix pattern used before” in its final message. The case passes the PoC and the developer’s test.
paragraphs.zh: 追踪。 在任何代码编辑之前，该智能体的推理过程已经注意到了错误描述中提供的回归提示，并决定从 Git 历史记录中寻找最初的修复方案。 随后，它执行了一次 git log 查询，按问题 #56 进行过滤，并检查了查询结果中的提交。 通过这种方式，它找到了提交 5793ebc，其中包含一个统一差异，该差异与当前问题的上游修复方案具有完全相同的 API 变更。 该智能体随后的编辑几乎逐行追踪了那个差异；最后，它在最终消息中引用了“之前使用的修复模式”。 该案例通过了 PoC 和开发者的测试。

paragraphs.en: Setup. In an earlier version of our harness, the agent ran as root inside the case container, as a consequence, the entire metadata directory was both readable and writable to it. The motivation was operational: we wanted to avoid permission errors during builds and dependency installation. Rather than inlining build/test/PoC content into the prompt, we instructed the agent to consult the metadata directory as needed. The directory, however, also contains sensitive files used by the post-agent evaluator, such as the upstream fix and the developer’s test. We re-created this configuration to drive the case in GitHub issue GH-13931 [ 29 ] of the PHP project, which contains an ASan-detected null-pointer dereference in phpdbg ’s compiler shutdown path.
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 在我们早期版本的测试框架中，智能体以 root 权限在案例容器内运行，因此整个元数据目录对它而言既是可读的也是可写的。 这样做的动机是出于操作上的考虑：我们希望避免在构建和依赖安装过程中出现权限错误。 我们没有将构建/测试/PoC 内容直接嵌入提示词中，而是指示智能体在需要时查阅元数据目录。 然而，该目录也包含后智能体评估器使用的敏感文件，例如上游修复文件和开发者的测试文件。 我们重新配置了这一设置，以在 PHP 项目的 GitHub 问题 GH-13931 [ 29 ] 中驱动该案例；该问题涉及在 phpdbg 的编译器关闭路径中检测到的 ASan 空指针解引用错误。

paragraphs.en: Trace. The agent’s first six tool calls all touched the metadata directory. Listing this directory revealed the existence of the YAML config file. paragraphs.en: Mechanism. The harness conflated two distinct sets of files: agent-visible task inputs (config, bug report, build/test scripts, PoCs) and evaluator-visible ground-truth metadata (upstream patch, developer’s tests, patch-commit references). Bundling both into a single mount made permission misconfiguration trivial: the agent did not need root, only read access to the wrong directory.
paragraphs.zh: 机制。 该工具将两组不同的文件混为一谈：智能体可见的任务输入（配置、错误报告、构建/测试脚本、概念验证）和评估者可见的基准元数据（上游补丁、开发者的测试、补丁提交引用）。 将两者合并为一个挂载点，使得权限配置错误变得轻而易举：智能体不需要 root 权限，只需对错误目录具有读取权限即可。

sents.zh: 机制。

sents.en: The harness conflated two distinct sets of files: agent-visible task inputs (config, bug report, build/test scripts, PoCs) and evaluator-visible ground-truth metadata (upstream patch, developer’s tests, patch-commit references).

sents.zh: 将两者合并为一个挂载点，使得权限配置错误变得轻而易举：智能体不需要 root 权限，只需对错误目录具有读取权限即可。

paragraphs.en: Implication. The agent and the evaluator must run in disjoint mounts, and the agent container should run as a non-root user. The launch script materializes only the inputs the agent is allowed to see (config without patch references, scripts, PoCs) into a separate path before starting the agent; the metadata directory in its full form is only mounted in the evaluator container. We recommend a discipline of one write role, one read role : the agent can only read what the harness has explicitly staged for it, and the evaluator’s view is invisible to the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 含义。 智能体与评估器必须在互不重叠的挂载点中运行，且智能体容器应以非 root 用户身份运行。 启动脚本在启动智能体之前，仅将智能体被允许查看的输入（不含补丁引用的配置、脚本和概念验证）生成到单独的路径中；其完整形式的元数据目录仅在评估器容器中挂载。 我们建议采用一种权限分离机制：一个写入角色和一个读取角色。智能体只能读取运行环境明确为其准备的资源，而评估器的视角对智能体而言是不可见的。

paragraphs.en: Symptom. Across many cases we observed unexpectedly long wall-clock times that did not match any obvious build or test latency. A given case might issue tens of Bash tool calls and accumulate tens of minutes of overhead even when each individual command, run outside the harness, completed in well under a second. Re-running the same commands from a shell inside the same container gave the expected sub-second timings, so the latency was not in the project under test.
paragraphs.zh: 症状。 在许多案例中，我们观察到意外漫长的实际运行时间，这些时间与任何明显的构建或测试延迟都不匹配。 某个特定案例可能会发出数十次 Bash 工具调用，并累积数分钟的额外开销，即使每个单独的命令在测试框架之外运行时完成时间远短于一秒。 在同一容器内的 shell 中重新运行相同的命令，得到了预期的亚秒级耗时，因此延迟并非来自被测试的项目本身。

paragraphs.en: Mechanism. Inspecting LiteLLM’s request log revealed two distinct streams of model traffic from a single agent run. The first stream targets the model alias we had configured ( anthropic/sonnet-4-5 ) and corresponds to the main agent loop; this stream succeeds normally. The second stream targets the bare model name claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 , which our LiteLLM configuration does not route, and corresponds to a per-Bash-command “safety” classification call that Claude Code issues internally. Each such call hangs for ≈ 120 \approx\!120 seconds—the underlying HTTP timeout—before Claude Code falls back to allowing the command anyway. The bash command then runs in a few milliseconds. Schematically, every bash invocation looks like: (1) Main model proposes Bash(...) ; (2) Claude Code calls claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 for safety classification; (3) no route; the call times out after ≈ 120 \approx\!120 s; (4) Claude Code defaults to “allow”; and (5) the Bash command is finally executed.
paragraphs.zh: 机制。 检查 LiteLLM 的请求日志后，发现单次智能体运行中产生了两条不同的模型流量流。 第一条流指向我们配置过的模型别名（anthropic/sonnet-4-5），对应于主智能体循环；该流正常成功执行。 第二条流指向原始模型名称 claude-haiku-4-5-20251001，我们的 LiteLLM 配置未对此进行路由，且对应于 Claude Code 内部针对每个 Bash 命令发出的“安全”分类调用。 每次此类调用都会挂起约 120 \approx\!120 秒——即底层的 HTTP 超时时间——之后 Claude Code 仍会默认允许执行该命令。 随后，Bash 命令会在几毫秒内运行完成。 从结构上看，每次 Bash 调用都遵循以下流程：（1）主模型提议执行 Bash(...)；（2）Claude Code 调用 claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 进行安全分类；（3）无路由匹配，调用在约 120 \approx\!120 秒后超时；（4）Claude Code 默认选择“允许”；（5）最终执行 Bash 命令。

sents.en: Mechanism.
sents.zh: 机制。

sents.en: Inspecting LiteLLM’s request log revealed two distinct streams of model traffic from a single agent run.
sents.zh: 检查 LiteLLM 的请求日志后，发现单次智能体运行中产生了两条不同的模型流量流。

sents.en: The first stream targets the model alias we had configured ( anthropic/sonnet-4-5 ) and corresponds to the main agent loop; this stream succeeds normally.

sents.en: The second stream targets the bare model name claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 , which our LiteLLM configuration does not route, and corresponds to a per-Bash-command “safety” classification call that Claude Code issues internally.
sents.zh: 第二条流指向原始模型名称 claude-haiku-4-5-20251001，我们的 LiteLLM 配置未对此进行路由，且对应于 Claude Code 内部针对每个 Bash 命令发出的“安全”分类调用。

sents.en: Each such call hangs for ≈ 120 \approx\!120 seconds—the underlying HTTP timeout—before Claude Code falls back to allowing the command anyway.
sents.zh: 每次此类调用都会挂起约 120 \approx\!120 秒——即底层的 HTTP 超时时间——之后 Claude Code 仍会默认允许执行该命令。

sents.en: The bash command then runs in a few milliseconds.
sents.zh: 随后，Bash 命令会在几毫秒内运行完成。

sents.en: Schematically, every bash invocation looks like: (1) Main model proposes Bash(...) ; (2) Claude Code calls claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 for safety classification; (3) no route; the call times out after ≈ 120 \approx\!120 s; (4) Claude Code defaults to “allow”; and (5) the Bash command is finally executed.
sents.zh: 从结构上看，每次 Bash 调用都遵循以下流程：（1）主模型提议执行 Bash(...)；（2）Claude Code 调用 claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 进行安全分类；（3）无路由匹配，调用在约 120 \approx\!120 秒后超时；（4）Claude Code 默认选择“允许”；（5）最终执行 Bash 命令。

paragraphs.en: The behavior is not visible in the agent’s stream-JSON output, in the harness logs, or in the LiteLLM logs of the configured alias—only in the LiteLLM logs of the unrouted exact model name, which an operator would have no reason to look at. The behavior also appears to be hard-coded into the most recent versions of Claude Code at the time we conducted our experiments: it cannot be disabled through agent settings or prompt instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 这种行为既不会出现在智能体的流式 JSON 输出中，也不会出现在测试框架日志或已配置别名的 LiteLLM 日志中——它只会出现在未路由的精确模型名称对应的 LiteLLM 日志中，而操作员完全没有理由查看该日志。 在我们进行实验时，这种行为似乎还被硬编码到了最新版本的 Claude Code 中：无法通过智能体设置或提示指令将其禁用。

paragraphs.en: Workaround. We mitigate the issue by setting the lesser-known environment variable ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL [ 4 ] in the agent container, which redirects the safety-check slot to our routed alias. paragraphs.en: Implication. The effect of this issue is not random; it disproportionately penalizes large projects in which the agent must navigate through many directories or run many tests, exactly the cases where the per-Bash 120 120 s tax compounds. A benchmark operator who is not aware of raw model traffic will read these as model-capability failures. More broadly, every closed-source agent harness may call sub-models the operator did not configure, or generally any hidden mechanics; benchmark designs must be aware of the possibility that such mechanics exist, monitor unexpected behaviors, and treat them as a run-invalidation event rather than a scored failure.
paragraphs.zh: 含义。 这个问题带来的影响并非随机；它会对大型项目造成不成比例的惩罚，因为智能体在这些项目中必须遍历大量目录或运行大量测试——而这恰恰是每次 Bash 操作超过 120 秒的惩罚会累积的情况。 不了解原始模型流量情况的基准测试操作员会将这些结果解读为模型能力方面的失败。 更广泛地说，每个闭源智能体框架都可能调用操作员未配置过的子模型，或者任何隐藏的机制；因此，基准测试设计必须意识到这类机制存在的可能性，监控意外行为，并将其视为运行无效事件，而非可计分的失败。

paragraphs.en: The collision. The upstream developer’s test also modifies ctx_test.go : it renames Test_Ctx_IsFromLocal to Test_Ctx_IsFromLocal_X_Forwarded and rewrites the body to assert the same property the agent’s added cases assert, and it adds the same "net" import. When the evaluator applies the developer’s test using git apply on top of the agent’s commit: the import-block hunk fails because the agent already added "net" , while the function-body hunk fails because the original Test_Ctx_IsFromLocal body that the diff expects to find has been replaced by the agent’s expanded version. git apply aborts the entire diff, the developer’s-test phase is recorded as a failure, and the case is scored fail despite the agent’s patch being functionally equivalent to (and arguably better tested than) the upstream one.
paragraphs.zh: 冲突。 上游开发者的测试也修改了 ctx_test.go：它将 Test_Ctx_IsFromLocal 重命名为 Test_Ctx_IsFromLocal_X_Forwarded，并重新编写了函数体，以断言智能体所添加的测试用例所断言的相同属性，同时还添加了相同的 "net" 导入。 当评估器使用 git apply 在智能体的提交之上应用开发者的测试时：导入块部分会失败，因为智能体已经添加了 "net"；而函数体部分也会失败，因为 diff 期望找到的原始 Test_Ctx_IsFromLocal 函数体已被智能体扩展的版本所替换。git apply 会中止整个 diff，开发者的测试阶段会被记录为失败，尽管智能体的补丁在功能上与上游的补丁等效（甚至可以说经过了更充分的测试），该测试用例仍会被判定为失败。

paragraphs.en: Mechanism. Developer-test application is a textual diff, not a semantic merge; any benign collision aborts the application. The collision in this case is not adversarial—the agent did exactly what its system prompt requested, namely add regression tests covering the security property—and the failure lives entirely in the scoring pipeline, not in the patch.
paragraphs.zh: 机制。 开发者与测试方的应用对比是文本差异，而非语义合并；任何无害的冲突都会导致应用终止。 此处的冲突并非对抗性的——该智能体完全按照系统提示的要求执行操作，即添加覆盖安全属性的回归测试——而失败完全出在评分流程中，而非补丁本身。

sents.zh: 机制。

paragraphs.en: Implication. Any added test files to the evaluation pipeline must be robust to such benign collisions, or scoped to files the agent is unlikely to touch. In our harness, before applying the added developer’s test, we revert all files that are modified in test.diff back to their original states. At minimum, the evaluator should distinguish test addition/application failure from test run failure , reporting the former as a pipeline error rather than as a patch failure, otherwise correct patches are penalized whenever they happen to touch the same test file the maintainer did, which for security fixes is common.
paragraphs.zh: 含义。 添加到评估流程的任何额外测试文件都必须能够抵抗此类良性冲突，或者限定在智能体不太可能触及的文件范围内。 在我们的测试框架中，在应用新增开发者的测试之前，我们会将所有在 test.diff 中被修改的文件恢复为其原始状态。 至少，评估器应当区分测试添加/应用失败与测试运行失败，将前者报告为流程错误而非补丁失败；否则，只要补丁恰好触及了维护者修改过的同一测试文件（对于安全修复而言这种情况很常见），正确的补丁就会受到惩罚。

paragraphs.en: We refer to these factors as “incidental” because they do not affect the majority of cases in full-dataset experiments and do not consistently manifest in the same instances across repeated runs. However, their impact is far from negligible. In our experiments, each individual factor can appear in as low as ≈ 5 \approx 5 % (Permission Misconfiguration) up to as high as ≈ 32 \approx 32 % (Test Collision) of cases across one complete run on our full dataset, and crucially, their effects are systematically biased rather than random. As a result, even a relatively small incidence rate can distort aggregate metrics and downstream uses of benchmark data.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这些因素称为“偶然因素”，因为在完整数据集实验中，它们不会影响大多数情况，并且在重复运行中也不会始终在相同的实例中显现。 然而，它们的影响远非可以忽略不计。 在我们的实验中，每个单独的因素在一次完整数据集的完整运行中，出现频率可能低至约 5%（权限配置错误），高至约 32%（测试冲突）；更重要的是，其影响是系统性地存在偏差的，而非随机的。 因此，即使相对较小的出现率也可能扭曲基准数据的汇总指标及其下游应用。

paragraphs.en: Despite their limited prevalence, incidental factors have a disproportionate impact in two key contexts:
paragraphs.zh: 尽管偶然因素的出现频率有限，但在两个关键情境中，它们却产生了不成比例的影响：

paragraphs.en: Leaderboard reporting. Modern LLM-based patching systems are often compared using aggregate success rates that differ by only a few percentage points. In this regime, even low-frequency distortions can alter the relative ranking of systems. For example, a framework issue affecting as little as 5 5 % of cases can shift the reported success rate enough to reverse leaderboard positions [ 36 ] . Because these distortions are not independent of system behavior—for instance, certain agents/models may be more likely to trigger timeouts, exploit leakage channels, or generate conflicting tests—they introduce systematic bias rather than uniform noise.
paragraphs.zh: 排行榜报告。 现代基于大型语言模型的补丁系统通常通过汇总成功率进行比较，而这些成功率之间的差异往往仅有几个百分点。 在这种情况下，即使是低频的失真也可能改变系统的相对排名。 例如，一个仅影响 5% 案例的框架问题，就足以使报告的成功率发生足够大的变化，从而逆转排行榜上的位置 [36]。 由于这些失真并非独立于系统行为——例如，某些智能体/模型可能更容易触发超时、利用泄漏通道或生成相互冲突的测试——因此它们引入的是系统性偏差，而非均匀噪声。

paragraphs.en: This phenomenon mirrors concerns raised in prior work on benchmark reliability and evaluation sensitivity, where small perturbations in evaluation setup can lead to significant changes in reported performance [ 23 , 39 ] . In the context of LLM agents, the problem is worsened by the complexity of the evaluation pipeline, where infrastructure-level artifacts can dominate model-level differences.
paragraphs.zh: 这一现象反映了先前关于基准可靠性和评估敏感性的研究中所提出的担忧：评估设置中的微小扰动可能导致报告的性能出现显著变化 [ 23 , 39 ] 。 在 LLM 智能体的背景下，评估流程的复杂性使这一问题更加严重，因为基础设施层面的因素可能会掩盖模型层面的差异。

Conversely, a case solved via unintended shortcuts, such as WebSearch leakage or access to git history, becomes a false positive , reinforcing spurious strategies such as copying ground-truth patches rather than reasoning about the bug.

paragraphs.en: This asymmetry is particularly problematic because learning algorithms amplify consistent biases in the training signal. Recently, studies of LLM benchmarking have highlighted how contamination and evaluation artifacts can be absorbed into model behavior during training [ 43 , 39 ] . Incidental factors act as an additional source of such bias: although they occur less frequently than systematic factors, their per-instance impact on the training signal is disproportionately large.

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these observations suggest that incidental factors should not be treated as edge cases or experimental noise. Instead, they represent a distinct class of evaluation failure modes that can meaningfully affect both reported performance and the quality of downstream models. A reliable benchmark must therefore detect, report, and where possible eliminate these factors, rather than averaging over them.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这些观察结果表明，不应将偶然因素视为边缘情况或实验噪声。 相反，它们代表了一类独特的评估失败模式，可能显著影响所报告的性能以及下游模型的质量。 因此，一个可靠的基准必须能够检测、报告并在可能的情况下消除这些因素，而不是对它们进行平均处理。

paragraphs.en: The controlled experiments in § 5 and case studies in § 6 demonstrate that agent-level, framework-level, and dataset-level factors can materially affect reported patch quality. We now ask: how prevalent are these pitfalls in existing benchmarks? To answer that, we surveyed 13 benchmarks and datasets that are commonly used in prior work for evaluating LLM-based vulnerability patching. Because these benchmarks differ in whether they provide an agent interface or execution infrastructure, we organize them into three categories (Table 5 ) that determine which factors from § 3 apply: LLM-agent patching benchmarks provide an agent harness or are used in prior work with LLM agents. All factors (A1–A2, F1–F3, D1–D4) apply. We also include the SWE-bench family in this category because it is widely used with LLM agents despite being agent-agnostic. Although its tasks focus on general software engineering rather than security vulnerabilities, it involves bug repair workflows where many of the pitfalls we analyze still arise.
paragraphs.zh: § 5 中的受控实验和 § 6 中的案例研究表明，智能体层面、框架层面和数据集层面的因素都会对报告出的补丁质量产生实质性影响。 我们现在要问：这些陷阱在现有基准测试中有多普遍？ 为了回答这个问题，我们调查了 13 个基准测试和数据集，这些数据集常被先前的工作用于评估基于 LLM 的漏洞修复。 由于这些基准测试在是否提供智能体接口或执行基础设施方面存在差异，我们将它们分为三类（表 5），这三类决定了 § 3 中的哪些因素适用：LLM-智能体补丁基准测试提供了智能体运行环境，或在先前的工作中与 LLM 智能体一同使用。 所有因素（A1–A2、F1–F3、D1–D4）均适用。 我们还将 SWE-bench 系列包含在这一类中，因为它尽管是智能体无关的，但被广泛用于 LLM 智能体中。 虽然其任务侧重于通用软件工程而非安全漏洞，但它涉及漏洞修复流程，而我们分析的许多陷阱在这些流程中仍然会出现。

paragraphs.en: a SWE-bench is agent-agnostic; permission model and internet control depend on which agent framework is used (e.g., SWE-agent provides its own container, but the benchmark itself does not enforce isolation). b Agentless delegates build/test to the SWE-bench Docker harness; it does not provide standalone scripts or an agent shell. c SWE-bench and MultiSWE-bench apply test_patch via git apply , which can conflict with agent-modified files (§ 6.5 ). d PatchAgent restricts the agent to three tools with no shell or web access, but does not enforce this via containerized network isolation. e Benchmark runs the project’s existing test suite on the agent-modified tree; the agent may modify or delete test files to influence the oracle outcome.
paragraphs.zh: a SWE-bench 与具体智能体无关；权限模型和互联网控制取决于所使用的智能体框架（例如，SWE-agent 提供自己的容器，但基准测试本身并不强制执行隔离）。b 无智能体的委托方将构建/测试任务交给 SWE-bench Docker 环境；它不提供独立的脚本或智能体外壳。c SWE-bench 和 MultiSWE-bench 通过 git apply 应用 test_patch，这可能与智能体修改的文件发生冲突（§ 6.5）。d PatchAgent 将智能体的工具限制为三种，且不提供外壳或网络访问权限，但并未通过容器化网络隔离来强制执行此限制。e 基准测试会在智能体修改后的项目树上运行项目的现有测试套件；智能体可能会修改或删除测试文件，从而影响 oracle 的结果。

paragraphs.en: D1, oracle granularity. Many security benchmarks rely on PoC-only oracles, which overestimate correctness (§ 5.3 ). SEC-bench, ARVO, and ExtractFix determine correctness solely by whether a single exploit input triggers a sanitizer report, which may allow superficial fixes that suppress crashes without addressing root cause. PatchAgent and Vul4C supplement the PoC oracle with the project’s existing regression tests; Vul4J provides source-level PoV tests extracted from the upstream fixing commit; VJBench relies entirely on the project’s existing test suite without any PoC execution. The SWE-bench family uses test-suite oracles.
paragraphs.zh: D1，预言机粒度。 许多安全基准仅依赖 PoC 预言机，这会导致正确性被高估（§ 5.3）。 SEC-bench、ARVO 和 ExtractFix 仅通过判断单个漏洞利用输入是否触发净化器报告来确定正确性，但这可能允许那些仅抑制崩溃而未解决根本原因的表层修复。 PatchAgent 和 Vul4C 在 PoC 预言机的基础上补充了项目现有的回归测试；Vul4J 提供了从上游修复提交中提取的源代码级 PoV 测试；VJBench 则完全依赖项目的现有测试套件，不执行任何 PoC。 SWE-bench 系列使用测试套件预言机。

paragraphs.en: D2, PoC format. No benchmark documents or controls the format in which PoCs are presented, despite its measurable effect on reported quality (§ 5.2 ). Among the five security benchmarks that supply PoCs (SEC-bench, PatchAgent, ARVO, ExtractFix, Vul4C), all use binary inputs exclusively. Vul4J and VJBench side-step the issue by relying on source-level test cases rather than PoC inputs, but this is an oracle-design choice (D1), not a deliberate PoC-format decision.
paragraphs.zh: D2，PoC 格式。 尽管 PoC 的呈现格式对报告的质量有可测量的影响（§ 5.2），但没有任何基准文档或控制机制对此进行规范。 在提供 PoC 的五个安全基准（SEC-bench、PatchAgent、ARVO、ExtractFix、Vul4C）中，所有基准都仅使用二进制输入。 Vul4J 和 VJBench 通过依赖源代码级别的测试用例而非 PoC 输入来规避这一问题，但这属于预言机设计的选择（D1），而非对 PoC 格式的有意决策。

sents.zh: D2，PoC 格式。

paragraphs.en: D3, source provenance and contamination. How the target source code is provisioned determines what incidental signals are exposed to the agent. SEC-bench, MultiSWE-bench, ARVO, ExtractFix, Vul4C, and VJBench all retain full, unsanitized git history, making the upstream fix commit discoverable via git log (§ 6.2 ). Only SWE-bench’s Python instances perform multi-step sanitization (remote removal, tag pruning, reflog expiry, aggressive GC); its non-Python instances only remove the remote. PatchAgent removes .git from the patch-application copy but not from the source-reading copy that the agent’s viewcode tool accesses, leaving git history partially exposed. Vulnerability collections (Big-Vul, CVEfixes, VADER) distribute source code as standalone snippets, database entries, or file archives rather than as repository checkouts, so git-history-based contamination does not arise from their design. However, researchers who repurpose these datasets for LLM-agent patch evaluation must supply their own source-retrieval step; naively cloning the upstream repository introduces the same contamination risk described above.
paragraphs.zh: D3、来源追溯与污染问题。 目标源代码的提供方式决定了哪些附带信号会暴露给智能体。 SEC-bench、MultiSWE-bench、ARVO、ExtractFix、Vul4C 和 VJBench 均保留了完整且未经净化的 git 历史记录，因此可以通过 git log 找到上游的修复提交（§ 6.2）。 只有 SWE-bench 的 Python 实例会执行多步骤净化（移除远程仓库、修剪标签、清理 reflog、激进垃圾回收）；其非 Python 实例仅移除远程仓库。 PatchAgent 会从应用补丁的副本中移除 .git，但不会从智能体的 viewcode 工具所访问的源代码读取副本中移除，导致 git 历史记录部分暴露。 漏洞集合（Big-Vul、CVEfixes、VADER）以独立代码片段、数据库条目或文件存档的形式分发源代码，而非作为仓库检出，因此其设计本身不会引发基于 git 历史的污染问题。 然而，若研究人员将这些数据集重新用于 LLM-智能体补丁评估，则必须自行提供源代码获取步骤；直接克隆上游仓库会引入上述描述的相同污染风险。

sents.en: D3, source provenance and contamination.
sents.zh: D3、来源追溯与污染问题。

sents.en: How the target source code is provisioned determines what incidental signals are exposed to the agent.
sents.zh: 目标源代码的提供方式决定了哪些附带信号会暴露给智能体。

sents.en: SEC-bench, MultiSWE-bench, ARVO, ExtractFix, Vul4C, and VJBench all retain full, unsanitized git history, making the upstream fix commit discoverable via git log (§ 6.2 ).
sents.zh: SEC-bench、MultiSWE-bench、ARVO、ExtractFix、Vul4C 和 VJBench 均保留了完整且未经净化的 git 历史记录，因此可以通过 git log 找到上游的修复提交（§ 6.2）。

sents.en: Only SWE-bench’s Python instances perform multi-step sanitization (remote removal, tag pruning, reflog expiry, aggressive GC); its non-Python instances only remove the remote.
sents.zh: 只有 SWE-bench 的 Python 实例会执行多步骤净化（移除远程仓库、修剪标签、清理 reflog、激进垃圾回收）；其非 Python 实例仅移除远程仓库。

sents.en: PatchAgent removes .git from the patch-application copy but not from the source-reading copy that the agent’s viewcode tool accesses, leaving git history partially exposed.
sents.zh: PatchAgent 会从应用补丁的副本中移除 .git，但不会从智能体的 viewcode 工具所访问的源代码读取副本中移除，导致 git 历史记录部分暴露。

sents.en: Vulnerability collections (Big-Vul, CVEfixes, VADER) distribute source code as standalone snippets, database entries, or file archives rather than as repository checkouts, so git-history-based contamination does not arise from their design.
sents.zh: 漏洞集合（Big-Vul、CVEfixes、VADER）以独立代码片段、数据库条目或文件存档的形式分发源代码，而非作为仓库检出，因此其设计本身不会引发基于 git 历史的污染问题。

sents.en: However, researchers who repurpose these datasets for LLM-agent patch evaluation must supply their own source-retrieval step; naively cloning the upstream repository introduces the same contamination risk described above.
sents.zh: 然而，若研究人员将这些数据集重新用于 LLM-智能体补丁评估，则必须自行提供源代码获取步骤；直接克隆上游仓库会引入上述描述的相同污染风险。

paragraphs.en: D4, language balance. Every security benchmark with execution infrastructure covers a single language family: C/C++ (SEC-bench, PatchAgent, ARVO, ExtractFix, Vul4C) or Java (Vul4J, VJBench). Vulnerability collections such as CVEfixes (27 languages) and VADER (15+ languages) offer broader language coverage but lack infrastructure. Among all surveyed benchmarks, only MultiSWE-bench combines multi-language support with execution infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: D4，语言平衡性。 每个具备执行基础设施的安全基准都只覆盖单一语言族：C/C++（SEC-bench、PatchAgent、ARVO、ExtractFix、Vul4C）或 Java（Vul4J、VJBench）。 像 CVEfixes（27 种语言）和 VADER（15 种以上语言）这样的漏洞集合提供了更广泛的语言覆盖，但缺乏执行基础设施。 在所有调查的基准中，只有 MultiSWE-bench 将多语言支持与执行基础设施结合在了一起。

sents.en: D4, language balance.
sents.zh: D4，语言平衡性。

sents.en: Every security benchmark with execution infrastructure covers a single language family: C/C++ (SEC-bench, PatchAgent, ARVO, ExtractFix, Vul4C) or Java (Vul4J, VJBench).
sents.zh: 每个具备执行基础设施的安全基准都只覆盖单一语言族：C/C++（SEC-bench、PatchAgent、ARVO、ExtractFix、Vul4C）或 Java（Vul4J、VJBench）。

sents.en: Vulnerability collections such as CVEfixes (27 languages) and VADER (15+ languages) offer broader language coverage but lack infrastructure.
sents.zh: 像 CVEfixes（27 种语言）和 VADER（15 种以上语言）这样的漏洞集合提供了更广泛的语言覆盖，但缺乏执行基础设施。

sents.en: Among all surveyed benchmarks, only MultiSWE-bench combines multi-language support with execution infrastructure.
sents.zh: 在所有调查的基准中，只有 MultiSWE-bench 将多语言支持与执行基础设施结合在了一起。

paragraphs.en: F1, permission model and harness isolation. No surveyed benchmark enforces a complete permission model that limits agent access at both the application and network layers. PatchAgent restricts agent actions to a defined tool set ( viewcode , locate , validate ) with no shell or web access. SWE-bench and MultiSWE-bench are agent-agnostic: they delegate isolation entirely to the agent framework (e.g., SWE-agent provides its own container, but the benchmarks themselves do not enforce boundaries). SEC-bench provides a partial harness with tag-based information separation but no documented permission model. AVR benchmarks provide no agent isolation, which is appropriate for their original scope but insufficient if repurposed for agent evaluation. When permission models are weak or absent, the source-provenance issues described in D3 become exploitable: agents with shell access can discover ground-truth fixes via git log or by reading mounted metadata.
paragraphs.zh: F1、权限模型和测试环境隔离。 所有已调研的基准测试均未强制实施完整的权限模型，以在应用层和网络层限制智能体的访问权限。 PatchAgent 将智能体的操作限制在预定义的工具体系（viewcode、locate、validate）内，不提供 shell 或网页访问权限。 SWE-bench 和 MultiSWE-bench 与具体智能体无关：它们将隔离责任完全委托给智能体框架（例如，SWE-agent 提供自己的容器，但基准测试本身并未强制执行边界限制）。 SEC-bench 提供了部分基于标签的信息分离测试环境，但未记录任何权限模型。 AVR 基准测试未提供任何智能体隔离机制，这与其原始用途相符，但若用于智能体评估则不足。 当权限模型薄弱或缺失时，D3 中描述的来源可信性问题便会成为可被利用的漏洞：拥有 shell 访问权限的智能体可通过 git log 或读取已挂载的元数据发现真实修复方案。

paragraphs.en: F2, timeouts and hidden mechanics. Only PatchAgent and SWE-bench document timeout thresholds; no benchmark monitors hidden sub-model calls. Without documented timeouts, capability failures are indistinguishable from budget exhaustion (§ 6.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: F2、超时和隐藏机制。 只有 PatchAgent 和 SWE-bench 记录了超时阈值；没有基准测试会监控隐藏的子模型调用。 如果没有记录在案的超时设置，能力故障将无法与预算耗尽区分开来（§ 6.4）。

sents.en: F2, timeouts and hidden mechanics.
sents.zh: F2、超时和隐藏机制。

sents.en: Only PatchAgent and SWE-bench document timeout thresholds; no benchmark monitors hidden sub-model calls.
sents.zh: 只有 PatchAgent 和 SWE-bench 记录了超时阈值；没有基准测试会监控隐藏的子模型调用。

sents.en: Without documented timeouts, capability failures are indistinguishable from budget exhaustion (§ 6.4 ).
sents.zh: 如果没有记录在案的超时设置，能力故障将无法与预算耗尽区分开来（§ 6.4）。

paragraphs.en: F3, test-patch collision. SWE-bench applies its test_patch via git apply without handling merge conflicts against agent-modified files; MultiSWE-bench follows the same pattern. Benchmarks that run the project’s pre-existing test suite on the agent-modified tree (PatchAgent, Vul4C, Vul4J, VJBench) face a complementary risk: the agent may modify or delete test files, inadvertently or deliberately, to influence the oracle outcome. Any evaluation that runs tests on agent-modified code should address this collision risk (§ 6.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: F3，测试补丁冲突。 SWE-bench 通过 git apply 应用其 test_patch，但未处理与智能体修改过的文件之间的合并冲突；MultiSWE-bench 也遵循相同的模式。 在智能体修改后的代码树上运行项目原有测试套件的那些基准测试（PatchAgent、Vul4C、Vul4J、VJBench）面临一种互补的风险：智能体可能会有意或无意地修改或删除测试文件，从而影响 oracle 的结果。 任何在智能体修改后的代码上运行测试的评估方法都应解决这种冲突风险（§ 6.5）。

paragraphs.en: A1, build and test instructions. Agent benchmarks generally provide build and test infrastructure, but whether and how these instructions reach the agent varies: SWE-bench and MultiSWE-bench are agent-agnostic and leave prompt content to the agent framework; PatchAgent abstracts building and testing behind its validate tool; SEC-bench places build scripts inside the container without documenting what the agent is told. No benchmark ablates the impact of build and test instructions on reported scores. Because different harness configurations can shift PoC-pass rates by up to 20 % (§ 5.1 ), two studies on the same dataset can report substantially different numbers without either being wrong.
paragraphs.zh: A1，构建和测试说明。 智能体基准测试通常提供构建和测试基础设施，但这些说明是否以及如何传递到智能体则各不相同：SWE-bench 和 MultiSWE-bench 与具体智能体无关，提示内容由智能体框架自行处理；PatchAgent 将其验证工具封装了构建和测试流程；SEC-bench 则将构建脚本置于容器内，但未说明智能体接收的具体指令。 没有任何基准测试分析了构建和测试说明对报告分数所产生的影响。 由于不同的测试环境配置可能使 PoC 通过率产生高达 20% 的差异（§ 5.1），因此针对同一数据集的两项研究可能会报告出显著不同的数值，而两者都不一定错误。

paragraphs.en: A2, internet and web-search access. PatchAgent and Agentless both prevent the agent from reaching the internet with restricted agent workflows, but neither enforces this at the network level. SWE-bench and MultiSWE-bench leave network policy entirely to the agent framework. SEC-bench containers use default bridge networking, which permits outbound connections. No surveyed benchmark enforces network-level isolation (e.g., --network=none or firewall rules). For benchmarks derived from historical bugs, web search provides a direct path to the upstream fix (§ 6.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: A2、互联网和网页搜索访问权限。 PatchAgent 和 Agentless 都通过限制智能体工作流来阻止智能体访问互联网，但两者均未在网络层面强制执行此限制。 SWE-bench 和 MultiSWE-bench 将网络策略完全交由智能体框架处理。 SEC-bench 容器使用默认的桥接网络配置，允许出站连接。 所调查的基准测试中，没有任何一个强制实施了网络层隔离（例如，--network=none 或防火墙规则）。 对于源自历史错误的基准测试，网页搜索提供了直接获取上游修复方案的路径（§ 6.1）。

paragraphs.en: Among the five LLM-agent benchmarks, none addresses all nine factors. Every pitfall identified in § 5 –§ 6 is present in at least one surveyed benchmark. PatchAgent covers the most ground—restricted tool set (F1), documented timeouts and iterative budget (F2), and regression tests supplementing the PoC oracle (D1). But it still lacks network-level isolation (A2) and full git-history sanitization (D3). SWE-bench provides strong source sanitization for Python instances (D3) and documented timeouts (F2), but delegates all agent-level and permission concerns to external frameworks (F1, A1, A2). SEC-bench and MultiSWE-bench leave the majority of factors unaddressed or undocumented.
paragraphs.zh: 在五个 LLM-智能体基准测试中，没有一个涵盖了全部九个因素。 § 5–§ 6 中识别出的每一个潜在问题，在至少一个被调查的基准测试中都存在。 PatchAgent 覆盖的范围最广——包括受限的工具集（F1）、文档明确的超时机制和迭代预算（F2），以及用于补充 PoC 预言机的回归测试（D1）。 但它仍然缺乏网络级别的隔离（A2）和完整的 git 历史清理功能（D3）。 SWE-bench 为 Python 实例提供了强大的源代码清理功能（D3）和文档明确的超时机制（F2），但将所有智能体级别和权限相关的问题都委托给了外部框架（F1、A1、A2）。 SEC-bench 和 MultiSWE-bench 则未处理或没有记录大多数因素。

sents.zh: 在五个 LLM-智能体基准测试中，没有一个涵盖了全部九个因素。

sents.zh: SEC-bench 和 MultiSWE-bench 则未处理或没有记录大多数因素。

paragraphs.en: AVR benchmarks and vulnerability collections are increasingly repurposed for LLM-agent evaluation despite not being designed for that setting. Repurposing either category requires supplying agent harnesses, oracles, and isolation—engineering choices that introduce the very confounds characterized in § 5 –§ 6 . In particular, unsanitized git histories (D3), absent permission models (F1), and unrestricted network access (A2) become immediate risks once an autonomous agent operates inside these environments.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 AVR 基准测试和漏洞集合并非为此类场景而设计，但它们正越来越多地被重新用于 LLM-智能体评估。 无论对哪一类进行重新利用，都需要提供智能体框架、预言机和隔离机制——这些工程选择恰恰会引发 § 5–§ 6 中描述的那些混淆因素。 特别是，未经清理的 git 历史（D3）、缺失的权限模型（F1）以及不受限制的网络访问（A2），一旦自主智能体在这些环境中运行，就会立即构成风险。

sents.en: AVR benchmarks and vulnerability collections are increasingly repurposed for LLM-agent evaluation despite not being designed for that setting.
sents.zh: 尽管 AVR 基准测试和漏洞集合并非为此类场景而设计，但它们正越来越多地被重新用于 LLM-智能体评估。

sents.en: Repurposing either category requires supplying agent harnesses, oracles, and isolation—engineering choices that introduce the very confounds characterized in § 5 –§ 6 .

sents.en: In particular, unsanitized git histories (D3), absent permission models (F1), and unrestricted network access (A2) become immediate risks once an autonomous agent operates inside these environments.

paragraphs.en: We translate the principles established across § 5 –§ 6 into a checklist that benchmark designers and model benchmark operators can apply directly.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将第 5–6 节中确立的原则转化为一个检查清单，供基准设计者和模型基准操作者直接应用。

paragraphs.en: G1 (from § 5.1 ). Disclose the harness’s information budget. Publish the exact prompt including any case-specific instructions provided, the list of tools, and the default values used in headline numbers.
paragraphs.zh: G1（来自 § 5.1）。 披露 harness 的信息预算。 发布完整的提示词，包括所提供的任何特定案例说明、工具列表以及标题数字中使用的默认值。

sents.en: Disclose the harness’s information budget.
sents.zh: 披露 harness 的信息预算。

sents.en: Publish the exact prompt including any case-specific instructions provided, the list of tools, and the default values used in headline numbers.

paragraphs.en: G2 (from § 5.2 ). Separate capability from knowledge. paragraphs.en: G3 (from § 5.3 ). Report developer-test results alongside PoC results. At minimum, a benchmark based on historical bugs should report both a crash-suppression rate and a developer-intent rate, understood as a lower bound on real patch quality. paragraphs.en: We propose a minimal reporting checklist that LLM vulnerability patching benchmarking reports should include: (1) The exact agent prompt(s) and any case-specific instructions included. (2) List of tools exposed to the agent, including network scope. (3) Source tree provenance and sanitization steps. (4) Oracle definition: PoC-only, regression, developer-test, or combination. (5) Inspection and analysis of the failure case logs with the failure taxonomy of G7.

paragraphs.en: Scope and external validity. Our dataset is intentionally small and highly curated: 112 cases across C/C++, Go, and Rust, restricted to projects with reproducible Dockerized builds, executable PoCs, and developer-added tests. This design improves experimental control, but it also introduces selection bias [ 18 ] . In particular, our cases likely overrepresent better-maintained projects and bugs with cleaner reproduction and validation artifacts. We therefore do not claim that the absolute pass rates reported here generalize to the full population of real-world bugs or to benchmark suites in other language ecosystems. Our goal is narrower: to identify and measure evaluation factors whose effects are large enough to remain visible even in a controlled dataset. For that purpose, controlled comparisons within a fixed harness are more important than scale alone.
paragraphs.zh: 范围与外部效度。 我们的数据集有意设计得较小且经过严格筛选：包含 C/C++、Go 和 Rust 中的 112 个案例，并限定为具有可复现的 Docker 化构建流程、可执行的证明概念（PoC）以及开发者添加测试的项目。 这种设计提升了实验的可控性，但也引入了选择偏差 [ 18 ] 。 具体而言，我们的案例很可能高比例地包含了维护更完善的项目，以及具有更清晰复现和验证流程的缺陷。 因此，我们并不声称此处报告的绝对通过率能够推广到真实世界中所有缺陷，或推广到其他语言生态系统的基准测试套件中。 我们的目标更为明确：识别并衡量那些影响足够显著、即便在受控数据集中也能显现出来的评估因素。 为此，在固定测试框架内进行受控比较比单纯追求规模更重要。

paragraphs.en: Our dataset versus real-world benchmarks. Our approach to uncovering benchmark pitfalls is to systematically inject factors that may influence outcomes into our own dataset via configuration flags, and then survey real-world benchmarks to assess whether these factors are present. We argue that this methodology is preferable to directly running individual benchmarks: it allows us to keep both the agent harness and dataset fixed while isolating and controlling each factor in separate experiments, rather than being constrained by the design and limitations of existing benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的数据集与真实世界基准的对比。 我们揭示基准测试潜在问题的方法是：通过配置标志，将可能影响结果的各类因素系统地注入到我们的数据集中，然后考察真实世界的基准测试，以判断这些因素是否存在。 我们认为，这种方法优于直接运行单个基准测试：它使我们能够在保持智能体框架和数据集不变的同时，在独立的实验中隔离并控制每个因素，而不会受到现有基准测试设计和局限性的约束。

paragraphs.en: Oracle validity. Developer’s tests are a stronger oracle than PoC-only evaluation, but they are not a perfect proxy for patch acceptability [ 31 , 34 ] . They capture the maintainer’s notion of correctness only to the extent that the upstream fix commit adds or meaningfully revises tests, and some upstream tests may themselves be incomplete or overly narrow. To reduce this threat, we exclude cases whose fix commits do not add meaningful test coverage, and we derive developer’s tests directly from upstream artifacts rather than authoring them ourselves. Even so, passing a developer’s test should be interpreted as evidence of closer alignment with maintainer intent, not as a proof of absolute correctness.
paragraphs.zh: Oracle 有效性。 开发者的测试比仅基于 PoC 的评估具有更强的 oracle 特性，但它们并非衡量补丁可接受性的完美代理 [31, 34]。 这些测试只有在上游修复提交添加或实质性修订了测试的情况下，才能反映维护者对正确性的理解；而某些上游测试本身可能并不完整或过于狭隘。 为降低这种风险，我们排除了那些修复提交未增加有效测试覆盖率的案例，并直接从上游产物中获取开发者的测试，而非自行编写。 即便如此，通过开发者的测试也应被解释为更贴近维护者意图的证据，而非绝对正确性的证明。

paragraphs.en: Agent, model, and run dependence. Absolute performance depends on the chosen agent/model pair and on run-level stochasticity [ 20 , 52 ] . Our controlled experiments use OpenCode with Claude Sonnet 4.0 for tractability, while our case studies use Claude Code with Claude Sonnet 4.5 to expose behaviors of a production closed-source agent. As a result, the exact percentages in § 5 should not be read as universal estimates of model capability. Our main claims instead concern differences across conditions with the dataset and harness held fixed—for example, the effect of build/test instructions, PoC representation, and oracle choice. These comparative patterns are less sensitive to the specific model choice than the absolute rates themselves. We likewise place more weight on large and consistent shifts (e.g., the 20-point C/C++ swing in § 5.1 ) than on small percentage-point differences that may fall within single-run variance.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体、模型和运行依赖关系。 绝对性能取决于所选的智能体/模型组合以及运行层面的随机性 [ 20 , 52 ] 。 为了便于分析，我们的受控实验使用 OpenCode 搭配 Claude Sonnet 4.0；而我们的案例研究则使用 Claude Code 搭配 Claude Sonnet 4.5，以揭示生产环境中闭源智能体的行为特征。 因此，§ 5 中的具体百分比不应被解读为模型能力的普适性估计值。 我们主要关注的论点，实际上是在数据集和测试框架保持不变的情况下，不同条件之间的差异——例如构建/测试说明、PoC 表示方式以及预言机选择所带来的影响。 与绝对速率本身相比，这些比较模式对具体模型的选择敏感度较低。 同样地，相比于可能处于单次运行方差范围内的小幅百分点差异，我们更重视那些显著且一致的变化（例如 § 5.1 中 C/C++ 性能 20 分的巨大波动）。

paragraphs.en: Memorization, contamination, and leakage. Because our cases are historical bugs drawn from public repositories, some fixes may have appeared in model training data [ 43 , 3 ] . This threat mainly affects absolute success rates. However, it does not explain the core findings of the paper, which are driven by changes in benchmark configuration while holding the underlying model fixed. Our experiments show that build/test instructions (§ 5.1 ), PoC framing (§ 5.2 ), and framework-level leakage or timeout behaviors (§ 6 ) substantially change measured outcomes without changing the target bug or the model. A pure memorization account also does not explain the persistent gap between PoC-pass and developer-test-pass rates (§ 5.3 ): if success were dominated by exact recall of upstream fixes, one would expect substantial alignment with developer-intent oracles. We therefore view memorization as a possible contributor to headline pass rates, but not as a sufficient explanation for the benchmark-sensitivity effects we report.

Recent work has popularized real-repository issue resolution as a benchmark for code agents, most notably SWE-bench and its multilingual extensions [ 12 ] , together with agent frameworks such as SWE-agent and Agentless [ 46 , 41 ] . Our goal is not to provide another benchmark catalog; instead, § 7 surveys existing benchmarks specifically through the lens of evaluation pitfalls such as oracle choice, source leakage, and configurations.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation methodology. Our closest antecedents are studies questioning whether benchmark scores faithfully measure the intended capability. In APR, Liu et al. [ 18 ] critically review the evaluation practices used to assess repair systems, and prior work has long shown that test-suite-passing patches can be plausible but incorrect or overfit to weak oracles [ 31 , 34 , 19 ] . In the LLM era, recent audits of SWE-bench-style evaluation similarly show that apparent issue resolution can diverge from true correctness [ 23 , 39 ] . More broadly, benchmark contamination and evaluation artifacts have become a central concern in LLM assessment [ 43 , 3 ] , and the machine-learning community has repeatedly warned that rapid benchmark progress can outpace empirical rigor [ 33 ] . Our contribution specializes these concerns to agentic vulnerability patching, where reliability depends not only on the dataset and oracle, but also on harness permissions, source sanitization, hidden agent mechanics, and post-patch evaluation pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: 评估方法。 我们最直接的前驱研究是那些质疑基准分数是否真实反映了预期能力的相关工作。在 APR 中，Liu 等人 [ 18 ] 对用于评估修复系统的实践进行了批判性回顾，而先前的工作早已表明，通过测试集的补丁可能看似合理，但实际可能不正确，或者对较弱的预言机出现过拟合 [ 31 , 34 , 19 ] 。 在 LLM 时代，近期对 SWE-bench 风格评估的审查同样显示，表面上的问题修复可能与真正的正确性存在偏差 [ 23 , 39 ] 。 更广泛地说，基准污染和评估人工产物已成为 LLM 评估的核心关注点 [ 43 , 3 ] ，机器学习领域也多次警告称，基准的快速进步可能超出经验验证的严谨性 [ 33 ] 。 我们的贡献将这些关注点专门应用于智能体漏洞修复领域，在该领域中，可靠性不仅取决于数据集和预言机，还依赖于权限控制、源代码净化、智能体的隐藏机制以及补丁后的评估流程。

paragraphs.en: Classical program repair. Automated program repair predates LLMs [ 13 ] , and many of the evaluation pathologies we study have clear precedents in that literature, especially the tension between test-suite adequacy and semantic correctness [ 31 , 34 , 19 ] . Our developer’s-test proposal inherits this lesson, but adapts it to modern agentic patching settings in which the model can localize, edit, execute tools, and exploit benchmark infrastructure.

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks for LLM-based automated vulnerability patching have become a de facto measure of progress, but we show that their headline numbers can be misleading. Reported success depends not only on the model, but also on prompt design, framework behavior, source packaging, and oracle choice. In particular, passing a PoC often overstates true repair quality: across our experiments, models improved much faster at suppressing benchmark symptoms than at producing patches that satisfy developer-intent tests.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型的自动化漏洞修复基准测试已成为衡量进展的实际标准，但我们发现，其表面数据可能具有误导性。 报告的成功不仅取决于模型本身，还依赖于提示设计、框架行为、源包配置以及“神谕”的选择。 尤其值得注意的是，通过概念验证（PoC）往往夸大了实际修复质量：在我们的实验中，模型在抑制基准测试症状方面的改进速度，远快于生成能通过开发者意图测试的补丁。

paragraphs.en: This appendix summarizes the evaluation harness used in § 4.4 . The full artifact contains per-language base images, per-case container recipes, agent images, a LiteLLM proxy, and scripts for launching cases and validating ground truth.

paragraphs.en: Each run is built in three layers: (1) a language-specific base image with the required toolchain, (2) a case image that checks out the upstream repository at the trigger commit and installs case-specific dependencies, and (3) an agent image that installs the agent runtime and launches the patching workflow under a non-root model user. For case-study controls involving source leakage, the harness can deliberately relax these defaults, but the headline configuration uses the isolated setup described below.
paragraphs.zh: 每次运行都由三层构建而成：（1）一个包含所需工具链的语言专用基础镜像；（2）一个在触发提交处检出上游仓库并安装案例特定依赖项的案例镜像；以及（3）一个安装智能体运行时并以非 root 模型用户身份启动打补丁工作流智能体的镜像。 对于涉及源数据泄露的案例研究控制，测试框架可以故意放宽这些默认设置，但主要配置使用的是下文描述的隔离设置。

paragraphs.en: Inside the container, the project source tree is exposed at /src/<project> and is the only location the agent is intended to modify. Per-case metadata is staged separately under /ssebench . In the default configuration, the agent runs as an unprivileged user and cannot read ground-truth artifacts such as the upstream patch or developer’s test. The evaluator, which runs after the agent terminates, retains full access to /ssebench . This separation is what allows us to study permission and leakage failures as controlled deviations rather than as properties of the default harness.

paragraphs.en: For Claude Code, the harness writes a per-case settings file that restricts tool permissions, disables web-search tools in the default configuration, and redirects internal sub-model slots to the configured LiteLLM endpoint. For OpenCode, the harness constructs an equivalent configuration against the same endpoint. Unless otherwise stated, all runs use a 1800-second wall-clock budget and a 500-turn budget.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Claude Code，该工具包会为每个用例编写一个设置文件，以限制工具权限、在默认配置中禁用网络搜索工具，并将内部子模型槽位重定向至已配置的 LiteLLM 端点。 对于 OpenCode，该工具包会针对同一端点构建一个等效的配置。 除非另有说明，所有运行都将使用 1800 秒的墙钟时间预算和 500 轮次预算。

paragraphs.en: All model traffic is routed through a LiteLLM proxy, which provides a uniform API surface across providers and preserves raw request logs for post hoc analysis. This indirection is important both for controlled model substitution and for diagnosing hidden agent behavior, such as the internal safety-model traffic discussed in § 6.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 所有模型流量都通过 LiteLLM 代理进行路由，该代理为不同提供商提供了统一的 API 接口，并保留了原始请求日志以供后续分析。 这种间接方式对于受控的模型替换以及诊断智能体的隐藏行为（例如第 6.4 节中讨论的内部安全模型流量）都至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Each case runs in a resource-limited Docker container attached only to an internal bridge network that exposes the LiteLLM proxy but not the public Internet. This enforces the default no-network policy for agents: even if application-level web tools are re-enabled, shell-based network access (e.g., curl or git fetch ) remains blocked unless the harness is intentionally reconfigured.
paragraphs.zh: 每个案例都在一个资源受限的 Docker 容器中运行，该容器仅连接到内部桥接网络，该网络只暴露 LiteLLM 代理，而不暴露公共互联网。 这强制智能体采用默认的无网络策略：即使应用级别的网页工具被重新启用，基于 shell 的网络访问（例如 curl 或 git fetch）仍然会被阻止，除非有意对运行环境进行重新配置。

paragraphs.en: After the agent terminates, the evaluator executes the four-phase pipeline described in § 4.3 : rebuild the project, run the PoC(s), run the pre-existing regression suite, and then apply the developer’s test and re-run the tests. Each phase is timeout-bounded, and failures in applying additional test patches are recorded as evaluation-phase failures rather than evaluator crashes.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体终止后，评估器会执行第 4.3 节中描述的四个阶段流程：重建项目、运行概念验证（PoC）、运行现有的回归测试套件，然后应用开发者的测试并重新运行这些测试。 每个阶段都有时间限制，而应用额外测试补丁时发生的故障会被记录为评估阶段故障，而非评估器崩溃。

paragraphs.en: Dataset curation uses a separate ground-truth validator built from the same case image but without any agent. It applies the upstream developer patch to a fresh checkout and runs the same four-phase pipeline. A case is included in the dataset only if the upstream patch passes all phases, ensuring that the benchmark instances remain internally consistent as scripts and metadata evolve.
paragraphs.zh: 数据集整理使用一个独立的基准验证器，该验证器基于相同的病例图像构建，但不包含任何智能体。 它将上游开发者的补丁应用于新的代码检出，并运行相同的四阶段流程。 只有当上游补丁通过所有阶段时，某个病例才会被纳入数据集，从而确保随着脚本和元数据的发展，基准实例仍能保持内部一致性。
